description: Vane (formerly Perplexica, rebranded March 2026) is a self-hosted, open-source AI-powered search engine that reads the web with an LLM and answers questions with citations — a self-hosted Perplexity AI alternative. This all-in-one image bundles the frontend, backend API, and a private SearXNG instance.
name: vane
title: Vane (formerly Perplexica)
